title: Indian timbers for furnitures and cabinets- Classification
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the general classification of Indian Timber species suitable for furniture and cabinets. It also lays down the general requirements of quality, moisture content and preservative treatment for the timber.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Preservation of Timber - Code of Practice

clause_3_terminology: Indian timbers for furnitures and cabinets

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
